mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods (store_id, name, images, description, category, points_required, stock, status, sort) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{name}, #{images}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{category},'redeem'), COALESCE(#{pointsRequired},0), COALESCE(#{stock},0), COALESCE(#{status},1), COALESCE(#{sort},0))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM goods WHERE id = #{id} AND store_id = #{storeId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM goods WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND category = 'claw' AND status = 1 AND stock > 0
mapper.update: UPDATE goods SET stock = stock - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND stock > 0
UPDATE goods SET stock = stock + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
